trial_court: Court of Sub Judge, Handwara; Suit captioned Ghulam Mohammad Sheikh & anr Vs. Samandar Thokar & ors
case_name: Mohammad Ramzan Thokur & Ors vs Samandar on 5 March, 2012
facts_of_case: Suit pending before the Court of Sub Judge, Handwara; two applications filed by petitioners (defendants); trial court allowed one application and dismissed another.

legal_principles.principle: The revisional power has to be exercised only in respect of orders which are final or the orders which, if made in favour of the party applying for revision, would result in termination of the suit or other proceedings.
legal_principles.held: What will emerge from the careful reading of the proviso is that the revisional power has to be exercised only in respect of the orders which are final or the orders which if would have been passed in favour of the party applying for the revision would result in termination of the suit or other proceedings independent of the suit i.e. which may have trappings of the suit.
cited_cases: Surya Dev Rai Vs. Ram Chander Rai & others, (2003) 3 SCC 675

legal_principles.principle: The revisional jurisdiction is taken away by the proviso inserted under sub-section (1) of Section 115 CPC in case the order of the High Court passed either way would not have the effect of finally disposing of the suit or other proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The exercise of revisional jurisdiction in such a case is taken away by the proviso inserted under sub-section (1) of Section 115 CPC. The amendment is based on the Malimath Committee's recommendations.
cited_cases: Surya Dev Rai Vs. Ram Chander Rai & others, (2003) 3 SCC 675
